summary: I sent the exact prompt. The agent loaded hyperpowers:requesting-code-review, read the code-reviewer.md template and dispatched a general-purpose reviewer subagent with the Agent tool over 06e8b85..24f6da1. The review says "Ready to merge? No". Critical 1 is the pagination offset (`page * size` with a 1-based page) and Critical 2 is the unawaited `store.saveOrder`. None of the code the story lists as correct got a blocking finding. withRetry and the config.json move came up only as Minor.
reasoning: Every criterion is backed by the session log (533931d9-...jsonl), the reviewer subagent's log under subagents/agent-a16b8900c0f355d92.jsonl, and the final screen. The agent never asked a clarifying question, so none of the scripted follow-up answers were needed.

observations.description: On first launch, the folder-trust dialog and the Bypass Permissions warning both have "No, exit" preselected, so I had to press Down before Enter on each.

The parent's summary of Important #4 drops the consequence the subagent stated ("stored with undefined"). Read alone, the parent's version names a category ("never validated") without saying what happens.
The final output includes a fairly long Codex review-gate notice with four plugin install commands (codex-plugin-cc was not installed). That is noise in a user-facing review summary.
The whole run took about 4m43s ("Crunched for 4m 43s"). After the reviewer returned, the parent read the source files again itself to confirm the findings, which added time.

criteria.criterion: Invoked requesting-code-review and dispatched a reviewer subagent via Agent
criteria.evidence: Tool calls in the session log, in order: Skill {"skill":"hyperpowers:requesting-code-review"}, then Read .../requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md, then Agent {"description":"Review code changes","subagent_type":"general-purpose","prompt":"You are a Senior Code Reviewer..."}. A subagent log file appeared under subagents/.

Under the Critical heading: "1. Off-by-one in pagination — page 1 skips the first page entirely. src/handlers.js:18 `const offset = page * size;` The JSDoc on line 12 declares page as 1-based... {page: 1, size: 10} returns ord_00000010–ord_00000019"

Under Critical: "2. store.saveOrder is never awaited — false 201s, then a process crash. src/handlers.js:31-38 ... a create with a missing or negative total returns {status: 201}, persists nothing, and takes the process down"
Subagent: "Ready to merge? No." Parent: "Don't merge yet — two confirmed Critical defects"

criteria.criterion: No blocking findings on correct code (header)
criteria.evidence: The Critical/Important findings are 1-6: offset, saveOrder, the no-arg listOrdersHandler call throwing, create-path validation, a weak pagination test, and negative page values. None of them targets the six items listed below.
It appears only under Minor: "7. withRetry is dead machinery on this call path... Only reachable via a config.json edit... hence Minor"
It appears only under Minor: "8. Moving config from a literal to a JSON file is unrelated scope, and adds an unhandled startup failure mode"
No finding mentions parseOrderId in either the subagent's report or the parent's final text. I checked this by reading the full final text in the log.
slice comes up only inside Minor 7 ("Array.prototype.slice... cannot throw") and Important 6, which is about negative page input to the handler, not a defect in the store's slice.
The try/catch is mentioned only inside Minor 7 as part of the retry machinery that "can never fire". There is no blocking finding about it.

criteria.criterion: Fixed clock / seeded 25 orders not blocking
criteria.evidence: Important 5 criticizes the test's assertions ("asserts shape, not content"), not the fixed clock or the seeded data. Test-state isolation shows up only as Minor 10.

criteria.criterion: Every Critical/Important cites file:line with trigger and outcome
criteria.evidence: Every blocking finding cites a file:line location and states a trigger and its outcome. Examples: #3 src/handlers.js:15, calling it with no arguments throws a TypeError. #4 src/handlers.js:36, a client can "omit it and the record is stored with undefined" (this is in the subagent's full text; the parent's summary shortened it). #6 src/handlers.js:16-18, {page:-2,size:10} returns data from slice(-20,-10).
